configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server that appears in the server list

configurationFields.label: Server Tags
configurationFields.description: Comma-separated list of server tags that give additional information about the server in the server browser

configurationFields.label: Server Steam Group
configurationFields.description: Sets the ID of the steam group that the server belongs to. You can find your group's ID on the admin profile page in the steam community

configurationFields.label: MOTD Countdown
configurationFields.description: Sets how long the MOTD panel lasts before it can be closed by clients

configurationFields.label: LAN Server
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will operate as a LAN server: no heartbeat, no authentication, and no non-class C addresses

configurationFields.label: Game Server Login Token (GSLT)
configurationFields.description: Sets the [Steam Game Server Login Token](https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers) for the server, to allow it to be listed in the server browser. Use app ID 265630 when generating the token

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required to connect to the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Initial Map
configurationFields.description: Sets the map to start the server with. If "Custom" is selected, Custom Initial Map must also be specified

configurationFields.label: Custom Initial Map
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom map to use for the Initial Map, if "Custom" is selected

configurationFields.label: Initial Game Mode
configurationFields.description: Set the initial game mode for the server

configurationFields.label: Server Region
configurationFields.description: Sets the server region shown in the server list

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Bot Player Count Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether to count bots as players for the player count in GSCS. This GSCS instance must be restarted for changes to this setting to take effect

configurationFields.label: Visible Player Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum players reported to prospective clients, regardless of the Player Limit. -1 = do not override

configurationFields.label: Allow Spectators
configurationFields.description: If set, spectator mode will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Pure Server Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether clients are only allowed to use certain files

configurationFields.label: Kick Clients On Pure Server
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will kick clients with mismatching files. Otherwise, it will issue a warning to the clients

configurationFields.label: Force Preload
configurationFields.description: If set, server side preloading will be forced

configurationFields.label: Enable Cheats
configurationFields.description: If set, cheat convars will be allowed to be used on the server

configurationFields.label: Disable Valve Anti-Cheat
configurationFields.description: If set, Valve Anti-Cheat (VAC) will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Enable IP Packet Filter
configurationFields.description: If set, enables packet filtering by IP mode. If disabled, everyone will treated as IP-banned, but their IP won't be added to the banlist

configurationFields.label: Server Tickrate
configurationFields.description: Sets the server tickrate

configurationFields.label: Allow Download From Server
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be allowed to download content from the server (maps, sprays and related)

configurationFields.label: Fast Download URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the URL for clients to download custom content from, instead of sourcing the content from the server. This allows for faster downloads

configurationFields.label: Allow Upload To Server
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be allowed to upload customisation files to the server

configurationFields.label: Maximum File Size
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum allowed file size for uploading to the server

configurationFields.label: Minimum Client Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum allowable bandwidth rate a client may have set when connected to the server. 0 = no minimum

configurationFields.label: Maximum Client Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum allowable bandwidth rate a client may have set when connected to the server. 0 = no limit

configurationFields.label: Minimum Server Update Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum number of updates per second of the positions of the server's models (players, guns, etc) that server sends to clients

configurationFields.label: Maximum Server Update Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of updates per second of the positions of the server's models (players, guns, etc) that server sends to clients

configurationFields.label: Decal Frequency
configurationFields.description: Sets the time between decal sprays

configurationFields.label: Ping Boost
configurationFields.description: Selects between optimised network code stack. Setting at 2 usually reduces latency toward 1ms without loss of activity input packets

configurationFields.label: Enable CPU Stats Collection
configurationFields.description: If set, CPU stats will be collected

configurationFields.label: Server/RCON IPv4 IP Binding
configurationFields.description: If required, you can change the IPv4 IP binding of the server and RCON by changing the Application IP Binding for this instance. NOTE: GSCS requires the server to be bound to a specific IP, rather than 0.0.0.0, for the server to log to GSCS's console. The IP must also be reachable by GSCS

configurationFields.label: Additional Command Line Parameters
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional [command line parameters](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Command_line_options#Source_Dedicated_Server) (anything that begins with a -) that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care

configurationFields.label: Additional Console Variables
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional [console variables](https://fistfuloffrags.blogspot.com/2014/10/cvarlist-autosave-cmd-autosave.html) (anything that begins with a +) that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care. Preferably, specify the equivalent under "Additional Server Settings"

configurationFields.label: Additional Server Settings
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional [settings](https://fistfuloffrags.blogspot.com/2014/10/cvarlist-autosave-cmd-autosave.html) to include in 'server.cfg' that are not otherwise set by GSCS. One setting per line

configurationFields.label: Enable Friendly Fire
configurationFields.description: If set, friendly fire will be enabled (teammates can cause damage to other teammates)

configurationFields.label: Enable Flashlight
configurationFields.description: If sets, allows the use of the flashlight by pressing the F button

configurationFields.label: Enable Footsteps
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will always play footstep sounds

configurationFields.label: Enable Auto Crosshair
configurationFields.description: If set, the auto crosshair will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Teamplay
configurationFields.description: If enabled, teamplay game rules will apply

configurationFields.label: Allow Players To Pause Server
configurationFields.description: If set, players will be able to pause the server. Not recommended

configurationFields.label: Allow Wait Command
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the wait command will be allowed on clients connected to the server. Recommended to keep disabled to prevent server crash exploits

configurationFields.label: Enable Voice Communication
configurationFields.description: If set, voice communication will be enabled on the server

configurationFields.label: Allow All Talk
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can communicate with all other players, with no team restrictions

configurationFields.label: Enable Fade To Black
configurationFields.description: If enabled, a player's screen fades to black for the remainder of the round after death (HUD and chat still works)

configurationFields.label: Force Respawn
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will be forced to respawn after death

configurationFields.label: Automatic Team Balancing
configurationFields.description: Sets whether to automatically balance teams based on the Teams Unbalance Limit

configurationFields.label: Teams Unbalance Limit
configurationFields.description: Teams will be considered unbalanced for the purpose of Automatic Team Balancing when one team has this many more players than the other team. 0 = check disabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Stalemate Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, the stalemate mode will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Stalemate Mode Time Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the time limit of the stalemate round

configurationFields.label: Map Rotation Time Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the game time per map. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Round Kill Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of kills at which the map ends. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Map Rotation Round Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of rounds to play before the map rotates. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Map Rotation Win Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum score one team can reach before the map rotates. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Restrict Spectator Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, the spectator mode for dead players will be restricted

configurationFields.label: Maximum Teams
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of teams for the server

configurationFields.label: Enable Bots Dynamic Join
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will have bots join or leave automatically to fill slots

configurationFields.label: Bots Slot Fill Percentage
configurationFields.description: Sets the slots percentage (expressed as a number between 0 and 1) filled by bots

configurationFields.label: Bots Skill Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the skill level of bots

configurationFields.label: AFK To Spectator Timer
configurationFields.description: Sets how long players can be inactive before they are sent to spectator

configurationFields.label: Warmup Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets the warm-up duration

configurationFields.label: Enable Competitive Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, the competitive variant mode will be enabled: there is no time limit and the first player reaching the specified Notoriety Points To Win wins the game. The leader loses notoriety points when killed (same amount that their killer gets)

configurationFields.label: Competitive Mode Notoriety Points To Win
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of notoriety points required to win the game in competitive mode

configurationFields.label: Enable Custom Shootout Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, a custom Shootout mode will be enabled: weapon crates, whiskey and physic items are placed by following a script instead of their default positions. Create a script using the bot editor

configurationFields.label: Alternate Ticks
configurationFields.description: If set, the server only simulates entities on even numbered ticks

configurationFields.label: Disable SourceTV
configurationFields.description: If set, SourceTV will be disabled on the server

configurationFields.label: Enable Automatic Demo Recording
configurationFields.description: If set, all games will be recorded as SourceTV demos

configurationFields.label: SourceTV Viewer Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of clients allowed to connect to the server's SourceTV. 0 = no SourceTV viewers are allowed, the game will only be recorded locally

configurationFields.label: Maximum SourceTV Bandwidth
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum SourceTV spectator bandwidth rate allowed. 0 = unlimited

configurationFields.label: Metamod and SourceMod Management
configurationFields.description: Sets how to manage Metamod and SourceMod on the server. Branch and Build Versions must be set accordingly for installation. Update the server after changing this setting (unless "Do nothing" is selected)

configurationFields.label: Metamod Branch
configurationFields.description: Specifies the [Metamod](https://www.metamodsource.net/downloads.php) branch to install

configurationFields.label: Metamod Build Version
configurationFields.description: Specifies the [Metamod build version](https://www.metamodsource.net/downloads.php) to install. Empty = latest build for the branch specified under Metamod Branch

configurationFields.label: SourceMod Branch
configurationFields.description: Specifies the [SourceMod](https://www.sourcemod.net/downloads.php) branch to install

configurationFields.label: SourceMod Build Version
configurationFields.description: Specifies the [SourceMod build version](https://www.sourcemod.net/downloads.php) to install. Empty = latest build for the branch specified under SourceMod Branch

deploymentSteps.name: Metamod Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "MetamodBuild=\"{METAMODBUILD}\" && MetamodBranch=\"{METAMODBRANCH}\" && if [[ -z \"$MetamodBuild\" ]]; then wget -qO metamod.tar.gz \"https://metamodsource.net/latest.php?os=linux&version=$MetamodBranch\" && echo \"Latest Metamod $MetamodBranch build downloaded\" && exit 0; elif [[ ! \"$MetamodBuild\" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid Metamod build version format specified\" && exit 1; fi; if { [[ \"$MetamodBranch\" == \"2.0\" ]] && [[ \"$MetamodBuild\" -ge 1391 ]]; } || { [[ \"$MetamodBranch\" == \"1.12\" ]] && [[ \"$MetamodBuild\" -ge 1221 ]]; }; then DownloadURL=\"https://github.com/alliedmodders/metamod-source/releases/download/$MetamodBranch.0.$MetamodBuild/mmsource-$MetamodBranch.0-git$MetamodBuild-linux.tar.gz\"; else DownloadURL=\"https://mms.alliedmods.net/mmsdrop/$MetamodBranch/mmsource-$MetamodBranch.0-git$MetamodBuild-linux.tar.gz\"; fi; wget -qO metamod.tar.gz \"$DownloadURL\" && echo \"Metamod $MetamodBranch build $MetamodBuild downloaded\""

deploymentSteps.name: Metamod Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $MetamodBuild='{METAMODBUILD}'; $MetamodBranch='{METAMODBRANCH}'; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($MetamodBuild)) { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"https://metamodsource.net/latest.php?os=windows&version=$MetamodBranch\" -OutFile 'metamod.zip'; if ($?) { Write-Output \"Latest Metamod $MetamodBranch build downloaded\"; exit 0 } } elseif ($MetamodBuild -notmatch '^\d+$') { Write-Output \"Invalid Metamod build version format specified\"; exit 1 }; if (($MetamodBranch -eq '2.0' -and [int]$MetamodBuild -ge 1391) -or ($MetamodBranch -eq '1.12' -and [int]$MetamodBuild -ge 1221)) { $DownloadURL = \"https://github.com/alliedmodders/metamod-source/releases/download/$MetamodBranch.0.$MetamodBuild/mmsource-$MetamodBranch.0-git$MetamodBuild-windows.zip\" } else { $DownloadURL = \"https://mms.alliedmods.net/mmsdrop/$MetamodBranch/mmsource-$MetamodBranch.0-git$MetamodBuild-windows.zip\" }; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $DownloadURL -OutFile 'metamod.zip'; if ($?) { Write-Output \"Metamod $MetamodBranch build $MetamodBuild downloaded\" }"

deploymentSteps.name: SourceMod Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "SourceModBuild=\"{SOURCEMODBUILD}\" && SourceModBranch=\"{SOURCEMODBRANCH}\" && if [[ -z \"$SourceModBuild\" ]]; then wget -qO sourcemod.tar.gz \"https://sourcemod.net/latest.php?os=linux&version=$SourceModBranch\" && echo \"Latest SourceMod $SourceModBranch build downloaded\" && exit 0; elif [[ ! \"$SourceModBuild\" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid SourceMod build version format specified\" && exit 1; fi; if { [[ \"$SourceModBranch\" == \"1.13\" ]] && [[ \"$SourceModBuild\" -ge 7311 ]]; } || { [[ \"$SourceModBranch\" == \"1.12\" ]] && [[ \"$SourceModBuild\" -ge 7225 ]]; }; then DownloadURL=\"https://github.com/alliedmodders/sourcemod/releases/download/$SourceModBranch.0.$SourceModBuild/sourcemod-$SourceModBranch.0-git$SourceModBuild-linux.tar.gz\"; else DownloadURL=\"https://sm.alliedmods.net/smdrop/$SourceModBranch/sourcemod-$SourceModBranch.0-git$SourceModBuild-linux.tar.gz\"; fi; wget -qO sourcemod.tar.gz \"$DownloadURL\" && echo \"SourceMod $SourceModBranch build $SourceModBuild downloaded\""

deploymentSteps.name: SourceMod Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $SourceModBuild='{SOURCEMODBUILD}'; $SourceModBranch='{SOURCEMODBRANCH}'; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($SourceModBuild)) { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"https://sourcemod.net/latest.php?os=windows&version=$SourceModBranch\" -OutFile 'sourcemod.zip'; if ($?) { Write-Output \"Latest SourceMod $SourceModBranch build downloaded\"; exit 0 } } elseif ($SourceModBuild -notmatch '^\d+$') { Write-Output \"Invalid SourceMod build version format specified\"; exit 1 }; if (($SourceModBranch -eq '1.13' -and [int]$SourceModBuild -ge 7311) -or ($SourceModBranch -eq '1.12' -and [int]$SourceModBuild -ge 7225)) { $DownloadURL = \"https://github.com/alliedmodders/sourcemod/releases/download/$SourceModBranch.0.$SourceModBuild/sourcemod-$SourceModBranch.0-git$SourceModBuild-windows.zip\" } else { $DownloadURL = \"https://sm.alliedmods.net/smdrop/$SourceModBranch/sourcemod-$SourceModBranch.0-git$SourceModBuild-windows.zip\" }; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $DownloadURL -OutFile 'sourcemod.zip'; if ($?) { Write-Output \"SourceMod $SourceModBranch build $SourceModBuild downloaded\" }"

deploymentSteps.name: SourceMod Installation
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location -Path 'fof/295230'; if (Test-Path 'fof/cfg/sourcemod') { Remove-Item -Path 'sm/cfg/sourcemod' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }; if (Test-Path 'fof/addons/sourcemod/configs') { Remove-Item -Path 'sm/addons/sourcemod/configs' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }; if (Test-Path 'fof/addons/sourcemod/plugins') { Remove-Item -Path 'sm/addons/sourcemod/plugins' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }; Copy-Item -Path 'sm/*' -Destination 'fof' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; Remove-Item -Path 'sm' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null"
